RETAIN_CANONICAL_AUTHORITY. Registry canonical project export: the same 100 in a different text format and order. Logical hash = registry baseline_hash.

RESEARCH_ONLY_LOCAL_BEST_IN_TESTED_POOL (zero genuine admissible swaps; the five-swap owner-presentation floor is not met, so NOT owner-presentable). Same 100 cards as the baseline, re-serialized (commander first, case-insensitive alphabetical, terminal newline); logical hash identical to the baseline.

REJECT (one-swap, staged; Pass C requested test). +Intuition -Long-Term Plans (an owner explicit keep). Bounded test T1/T2: Long-Term Plans' third-from-top card is captured at once by Jeleva's ETB (X>=4), so the 'waits two draws' premise is false; Intuition never stages a library card for Jeleva, and the exhaustive hostile-choice enumeration shows the Breach/LED/Brain Freeze and Oracle piles both fail (the opponent hands over the dead piece). It removes one of 11 Jeleva stagers (P>=1 stager at 8 cards seen 0.6246 -> 0.5875). Commander Spellbook 7 -> 7.

REJECT (one-swap, staged; Pass C requested test). +Intuition -Scheming Symmetry. Scheming Symmetry costs {B}, needs two different target players (CR 115.3) and puts the card on top for Jeleva's ETB; Intuition costs 3, stages nothing and fails the hostile pile enumeration for the deck's two-card lines. Same stager loss as above; Spellbook 7 -> 7.

REJECT (one-swap, staged; Pass C requested test). +Galvanic Iteration -Borne Upon a Wind. Galvanic copies are not cast (CR 707.10), so no storm count; eight of the deck's key instants/sorceries gain nothing or are harmed by a copy (Demonic Consultation, Doomsday, Final Fortune, Mnemonic Betrayal, Peer into the Abyss, Tainted Pact, Toxic Deluge, Yawgmoth's Will). Borne is one of four Jeleva haste/flash enablers (end-step Jeleva); P(>=1 enabler) 0.2577-0.3514 with Borne vs 0.1994-0.2760 with Galvanic over 7-10 cards. Spellbook 7 -> 7.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (one-swap, staged; not counted). Snap protects Jeleva, resets her to a larger X and is free with two untapped lands; EDHREC cEDH 11/30 vs Gitaxian Probe 17/30, and Probe is a 0-mana storm/LED/Breach enabler. Evidence does not clearly beat the incumbent; offered as an owner decision only.

REJECT (one-swap off-ranking challenge). Spellseeker reaches 29 MV<=2 instants/sorceries and is a Wizard for Harmonic Prodigy, but costs 3 vs a free counter that protects the Breach/Oracle turns; cEDH 5/30 vs 16/30.
REJECT (one-swap). U/B/R source counts unchanged (21/20/19); gives opponents chump bodies and an extra permanent; cEDH 9/30 vs 18/30.
REJECT (one-swap off-ranking challenge). Hanweir Battlements gives Jeleva haste repeatedly but makes only {C}: red sources 19 -> 18; absent from the cEDH sample.

REJECT (two-swap data-led package). Highest-inclusion new combo package (Dramatic Reversal 11/30, Isochron Scepter 8/30) adds Spellbook 4821-5261 (7 -> 8 combos) but is a generic Grixis line with no Jeleva text, homogenizes toward the Kess/Inalla cores and cuts Scroll Rack, an owner explicit keep; the owner-direction rule is not clearly beaten.
